items.title: A Joyful Dining Hall
items.text: A warm space where food becomes part of learning and independence.

items.title: Life Skills
items.text: Children serve themselves, use cutlery, pour water and practise table manners.

image.alt: Children sitting together in a warm, cosy classroom

items_2.title: Balanced Nutrition
items_2.text: Wholesome, planned platters help children explore tastes and textures at their own pace.

items_2.title: A Happy Relationship With Food
items_2.text: Children leave nourished, confident and well-mannered, and enjoy their food.
